## Context / Problem
Discovered while triaging breezy-hogged-mastiff, which owns `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/unclassified.args`. These 11 entries move to `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/store-history.args`, which this bug owns.

`tests/integration/test_b636_rebuild_history_loss.py` (3) restores nothing from tickets history, `tests/interfaces/store/test_fsck_repair_restore_08c8.py` (5) reports `rebuilt is False`, and `tests/unit/test_store_write_unmerged_recovery.py` (3) cannot create its `UU` fixture (`git ls-files -u` is empty). The fsck restore tests passed when run serially on Windows (run 44672240702: 5 passed) but fail under xdist (runs 44665461131 and 44681457334), so an interaction between tests is in play. Forcing `core.autocrlf=true` on macOS does not reproduce them.

Evidence: Windows runs on throwaway branch `tmp/w05-remeasure` with origin/main `717c50f8b33` code plus a selection-only workflow change: run 44665461131 (the 242 `unclassified.args` entries; 48 passed, 194 failed or errored) and run 44681457334 (the 194, xdist, JUnit XML with full tracebacks). Both 2026-11-19 PST.

Modules:
- `tests/integration/test_b636_rebuild_history_loss.py` (3)
- `tests/interfaces/store/test_fsck_repair_restore_08c8.py` (5)
- `tests/unit/test_store_write_unmerged_recovery.py` (3)

## Approach
Reproduce on a Windows runner with `-p no:randomly` and single-test runs to separate the interaction from a platform cause, then fix the class. Remove each line from `store-history.args` as it passes.

## Scope
Test or product code for the listed modules, plus `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/store-history.args` (remove each fixed line; delete the file and its `@` reference in `.github/workflows/test.yml` once empty).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every line removed from `store-history.args` names a test that passed in a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the fix (run id recorded in a comment).
- [ ] `store-history.args` is empty and deleted with its reference in `.github/workflows/test.yml`, or each remaining line names a test recorded on this ticket as intentionally unsupported on Windows with the reason.

file_impact.reason: remove each line as its test is fixed
